overview.about: LIV Golf Louisiana is held at Bayou Oaks at City Park in New Orleans, a municipal layout in the heart of one of America's most distinctive cities. The event pairs LIV's golf with the food, music and culture of the Big Easy.
overview.nextEvent: The next LIV Golf Louisiana is decided over 54 holes at Bayou Oaks, individual and team titles together. The flat, water-dotted City Park setting sits minutes from the French Quarter.
